summary: Kathy Hochul's public framing of the conflict centers on Israeli victims and hostage return. She declared herself 'staunchly pro-Israel' in December 2025 and pledged to 'always stand up for the Israeli people' on the two-year anniversary of October 7. Her statements expressing grief over child starvation in Gaza and her endorsement of the March 2024 ceasefire deal remain within that Israel-centric frame, which placed the onus on Hamas to accept the agreement.
